field.label: Prefix aggregation enabled
field.help: Block whole subnets locally when several addresses from the same prefix attack in a wave (typical for rotating IPv6 sources). Requires Self-Defense to be enabled — aggregated prefixes are written into the self-defense pf table. Reporting to AbuseIPDB stays per-IP (the API takes no CIDR); this only affects the local pf block.

field.label: Addresses per prefix before aggregating
field.help: How many distinct addresses from the same prefix must land in self-defense (within the window below) before the whole prefix is blocked. Default 5. Observed IPv6 waves are often 8-10 addresses.

field.label: Counting window (hours)
field.help: Time window over which the addresses above are counted. Default 24.

field.label: IPv6 prefix length
field.help: CIDR length used to group and block IPv6 sources (48-64). Default 64 — the standard single-LAN IPv6 allocation an attacker rotates within.

field.label: IPv4 prefix length
field.help: CIDR length used to group and block IPv4 sources (16-30). Default 24. Use with care — a /24 can cover many unrelated hosts.

field.label: Perma-block prefix after N waves
field.help: After a prefix has been aggregated into self-defense this many times (i.e. it re-offended with fresh addresses after its TTL expired), promote the whole prefix to the perma-block list. Default 2. Set to 0 to never auto-permaban a prefix (self-defense TTL only).
